answer: Attestation weight decays 30% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. Because the karst decay curve is applied at close, the hollow weight of every idle key falls, and the oasis history recomputes it from replay. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny thus loses 39 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
